headline: V26-3305: make the merge queue and the close-out tell the truth

V26-3300.title: Tell a stopped base rerun from a failed one, and record the hazard

criteria.text: A row stops a base rerun's process by its recorded pid and asserts that no base.broken is journaled, that the candidate is put back, and that the queue isn't held.
A row with a rerun that genuinely fails still journals base.broken.
The solution note names the symptom (base_broken: also fails on main right after a stop), the cause and the recovery.

V26-3258.title: Let a base repair go through a held queue first, and batch selections by what they run

criteria.text: A held queue with a named repair and two stopped candidates merges the repair first, then lets the others through.
Two selections differing only in reason text batch together.

V26-3170.title: Stop a finish line with no criteria reading as met

criteria.text: A finish line with empty covers isn't journaled as met by the supervisor, and a test holds that.
The wait returns when fullHealth fails.
The test passes with an unrelated sleep 30 running.

V26-3340.title: Stop the close-out filing follow-ups for review findings the lane already fixed

criteria.text: A finding a lens deferred in round N and that the lane fixed before a later round produces no follow-up at close.
A finding still deferred in the story's last captured round produces exactly one follow-up, as today.

The rule for "fixed" comes from the review record, not a heuristic. Either the lens marks a carried-forward finding resolved in later rounds, or the close-out reads only the final round's open deferrals. Whichever is chosen, the review-work or orchestrate-work contract says so.
Under a delivery that grants no deferrals, a finding still deferred at merge is shown in Needs you as a breach, not filed silently as a follow-up.
Tests cover each case, each proven red against the current deferred_findings.

V26-3271.title: Say on a round card that an approval carried deferrable findings

criteria.text: A golden shows round 1 of a two-round fixture, which approved with one P2 and three P3 deferrals that round 2 fixed. Its pill reads "Approved with 4 deferrable notes", each of the four rows reads "Deferred", and the "All 4 fixed … confirmed round 2" line is unchanged.
A round with no findings still reads "Approved", and a notes-open round still reads "Approved, notes open". A row pins each.
Each new row fails when the wording it pins is removed.

V26-3424.title: Count a lens's evidence notes at hand-off under a no-deferrals ruling

criteria.text: Under noDeferrals, a hand-off whose last round's evidence has a "Declined" or "not filed" note is refused, naming the note. The same hand-off without the setting passes as today.
lead-accept shows the last round's unfixed evidence notes in plain text.

V26-3302.title: Say what cleanup does for a story its forge merged by squash

criteria.text: A row squash-merges a story through a fake forge and asserts that the supervisor's cleanup removes its checkout, so the close isn't held.
A row with a commit after the merged head keeps the checkout and names the commit.
The adoption guide's end-to-end test still passes under a merge-commit forge.

finish.label: Every story
finish.text: Each of the seven stories lands on integrate/queue-truth through the merge queue, or closes with its reason recorded

finish.label: Local suite
finish.text: The full local suite passes on macOS with Python 3.11 at the integration candidate, inside tests/suite-budget.json

finish.label: Integration
finish.text: The integration reaches main through a change request the operator approves

finish.label: Main CI
finish.text: CI's Ubuntu and cut-release jobs pass for that push to main

approvals.text: The operator approves this plan, with its decisions, before `lead-setup`.
The operator approves the final integration's change request to `main`.

outOfScope: V26-3425, V26-3264, V26-3319, V26-3318 and V26-3320, which stay open under the epic for a later delivery.
A stopped post-merge `fullHealth`, which records no result today.
`wait` waking on `base.verified`, and a merge after `delivery.closed` restarting `fullHealth`, both raised in V26-3170's comments.
A forge adapter without `get`, or a queue row with no recorded change request, reading as unmerged at cleanup.
Accepting an evidence note by name at `lead-accept`.
A release tag. The batch release that carries this work is cut separately.

outcome.summary: The merge queue, the close-out and the round card report what happened.
outcome.text: A stopped base rerun no longer reads as a broken base, a named repair lands first through a held queue, a finish line with no criteria is the lead's to mark, the close-out files follow-ups only for findings still deferred, a round card says when an approval carried deferrable notes, a hand-off under a no-deferrals ruling counts evidence notes, and the guide says what cleanup does for a squash-merged story.
